Name: brand-web-security-headers
Comment: Response headers for the web app on CloudFront (plan C11, C16). Allows Razorpay Checkout and the Google Maps JavaScript API (per both vendors' CSP guidance). For staging, replace api.brand.in with api.staging.brand.in in connect-src and img-src. Photos come from ImageKit, so img-src allows ik.imagekit.io; add your own domain here too if you put one in front of it. Website sections (ADR-0021): Google Forms (docs.google.com) and YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com, thumbnails from i.ytimg.com) can be embedded, and videos play from the site or ImageKit; admin-chosen fonts come from Google Fonts.

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://checkout.razorpay.com https://maps.googleapis.com https://*.gstatic.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://api.brand.in https://ik.imagekit.io https://*.googleapis.com https://*.gstatic.com https://*.google.com https://*.googleusercontent.com https://*.razorpay.com https://i.ytimg.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.brand.in wss://api.brand.in https://*.googleapis.com https://*.google.com https://*.gstatic.com https://api.razorpay.com https://lumberjack.razorpay.com; frame-src https://api.razorpay.com https://checkout.razorpay.com https://*.google.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; media-src 'self' https://ik.imagekit.io; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

Items.Value: geolocation=(self), camera=(), microphone=(), payment=(self "https://checkout.razorpay.com"), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
